1) CHRs are a useful and powerful framework for describing type inference for user-programmable extensions to type classes; 2) functional dependencies are a special case of such extensions, and can be described by CHRs; 3) functional dependencies allow for type inference under certain conditions; 4) the conditions can be relaxed without sacrificing soundness or decidability.
